--- pemu core v1: three IHP 256x16 bm_bist SRAM macros, 8x4 tile, floorplan C (user decision 2026-10-19; log/ci_results_v1.md) ---
Custom PDN_CFG = LibreLane's default minus the macro grid (PDN-0233 on the single-layer tile). Power reaches the macro through Pemu.MacroColumnStripes (librelane_plugin_pemu_pdn.py).

check_power_grid runs inside GeneratePDN, before the stripe step connects the macro, so its count is not a verdict. Verdicts: Pemu.MacroColumnStripes property check (fails the step), LVS, IR drop report.

Tiny Tapeout pin rule (precheck/pin_check.py): every VPWR/VGND port must reach within 10 um of the top and bottom die edges. Run 094ea6a failed it: the macro carves the 12 stripes over its x-span. Fix (user decision 2026-10-17): no stripes over the macro except the 2 aligned pairs (PDN_OBSTRUCTIONS on the 4 misaligned pairs, full tile height), and the step makes the aligned 4 full height across the macro, pins included.

Floorplan C: lane-1 imem + store stacked at x = 3.36, lane-0 imem at x = 1431.04. Each 256x16 macro has two aligned stripe pairs (k = 0,1 left; 32,33 right; VPWR centres 9.03 + 44.96k). The 7 misaligned pairs crossing the macros (k = 2-5, 34-36) are removed over the full tile height (TT pin rule).

Crossing the VDD!/VDDARRAY! Metal4 OBS bar (y 38.825-45.465 in the 256x16 bm_bist master): RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x16_c2_bm_bist.gds (PDK 2bbec755, blob 77d647dd) has 0 Metal4 (50/0) and 0 Via3 (49/0) polygons under all 4 aligned VPWR footprints (macro x 4.62-6.72, 49.58-51.68 left column; 15.66-17.76, 60.62-62.72 right macro), nearest Metal4 2.97-3.16 um (flow/pdn/check_sram_bar_gds.py; injected-metal control BLOCKED). Magic extraction reads the LEF abstract and reports these crossings as illegal overlaps, hence ERROR_ON_ILLEGAL_OVERLAPS 0; KLayout DRC checks the real GDS.

Run 0f4d84e: A_DOUT[5] (7 direct decode loads, left unbuffered by pre-route repair) at 0.065-0.069 pF vs the SRAM's 0.064 pF max cap after routing. Post-global-route repair (agent choice, delegated by the user 2026-10-17) re-runs repair_design with global-route parasitics (margin GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_CAP_PCT, default 10). LibreLane default is false.

Run dad0fc3: post-GRT repair ran but saw only 4 fanout violations; A_DOUT[5] stayed at 0.0654 (typ) / 0.0675 (fast) pF vs 0.064 after detailed routing, i.e. the routed load is at least 13% above the global-route estimate. Margin 10 -> 30 makes post-GRT repair buffer nets estimated above 0.0448 pF.

Floorplan C (user decision 2026-10-19). All FS: signal pins (Metal2) on the top edge, facing the logic and the TT IO pins (y = 710), as chosen for the 64x16 on 2026-10-17 (with N, A_DOUT exceeded max cap). Left column x = 3.36 (VDD/VSS columns of the left bit-cell group under the stripe pairs at 9.03/14.65 and 53.99/59.61): lane-1 store at y = 41.58, lane-1 imem at y = 207.90 (47.5 um pin channel above the store). Right macro x = 1431.04 (pairs at 1447.75 and 1492.71), y = 41.58: one stripe pitch left of the first choice (1476.0), whose 8.5 um gap to the core edge made pdngen add a 1.05 um VGND strap that failed the TT pin rule (CI run 1, C4); the 53.4 um gap now holds the full pair k = 37. y >= 41.58 leaves carved stripe segments below every macro, which the full-span step needs.
